# cb:b568

> Atomic lifecycle commits: every commit recording an authoring-lifecycle transition records exactly one transition of one artifact - one thread captured or updated, one focus brief opened, updated, or graduated, one focus's manifest rows minted. A commit conjoining separable lifecycle events is a mis-authored bundle, split at commit time: the belief atomicity doctrine transposed from nodes to commits. Atomic means one event, not one file - a brief together with the index and manifest updates it forces is one event. Typed trailers (Thread:, Focus:, Belief:) therefore map one-to-one onto commits, so a trailer grep returns exactly one artifact's history.
